title: Best era of New Orleans music and how it changed
summary: Zardis says the late 1920s were the best time, and describes changes in solos, rhythm section, drum beats and banjo.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
